source: KanjiVG (https://kanjivg.tagaini.net/), copyright Ulrich Apel and contributors
changes: Changed by LineType in October 2026: each stroke path sampled into a polyline of points, scaled into the pad and rounded to whole units; the six basic strokes (一丨丶丿亅乙) moved to the middle of the box. Only the characters LineType teaches.
format: Each character is a list of strokes in writing order; each stroke is a flat list of x, y points along its centre line (x0, y0, x1, y1, ...), in a 480 x 560 pad with the character in a box from about (65, 70) to (415, 420), y pointing down.
